tools.name: check_partita_iva_format
tools.description: Free offline check of an Italian partita IVA (11 digits + check digit). Does not confirm registration.

tools.name: lookup_italian_pa
tools.description: Look up an Italian public administration or public-service operator by 11-digit codice fiscale in IndicePA (AgID). Use when an agent must verify a public-sector counterparty, find its official PEC (certified email) addresses, or confirm it exists before e-invoicing. Costs $0.005 in USDC (or 0.005 EURC) on Base via x402, charged on every paid call (also not found, malformed codice fiscale or IndicePA unavailable): check the 11 digits first. Unpaid calls return the x402 v2 payment requirements (isError, not charged); pay per call with an x402 MCP client (payment in params._meta["x402/payment"], e.g. @x402/mcp). Docs: https://github.com/yeick010/italycheck

tools.name: verify_italian_counterparty
tools.description: Verify an Italian counterparty in one call before invoicing or paying: partita IVA / codice fiscale check digit, IndicePA public-administration record (name, category, institutional PEC, address) and the e-invoicing offices that receive FatturaPA via SDI (codice univoco ufficio, start date, PEC). Returns verdict pa_verificata | formato_valido_non_verificato | formato_non_valido with sources and CC BY 4.0 attribution. Public-administration data only: private companies are not confirmed (no VIES, no company PEC). Malformed input, a wrong check digit or an IndicePA outage are not charged. Costs $0.01 in USDC (or 0.01 EURC) on Base via x402. Unpaid calls return the x402 v2 payment requirements (isError, not charged); pay per call with an x402 MCP client (payment in params._meta["x402/payment"], e.g. @x402/mcp). Docs: https://github.com/yeick010/italycheck
